title: Chain rule with Schwarz symmetry for the coefficient field DPsi(Du)
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, L := L(R^n, R^l) (= Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, operator norm) and Psi : L -> R of class C^2. Let U ⊆ R^n be open and u : R^n -> R^l of class C^2 on U. Then for every e in R^n and every y in U, D(z -> DPsi(Du(z)))(y)e = D^2Psi(Du(y))[Dv_e(y)] in L* = L(L, R), where v_e(z) := Du(z)e = fderiv R u z e and D^2Psi(P)[Q] := fderiv R (fderiv R Psi) P Q.
lean_statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, ∀ (Ψ : (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) → ℝ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (u : Rn n → Rn ℓ), IsOpen U → ContDiff ℝ 2 Ψ → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 u U → ∀ (e y : Rn n), y ∈ U → fderiv ℝ (fun z => fderiv ℝ Ψ (fderiv ℝ u z)) y e = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Ψ) (fderiv ℝ u y) (fderiv ℝ (fun z => fderiv ℝ u z e) y)
